name: Forgiving One Another
overview: Scripture teaches that forgiving one another is essential for receiving God's forgiveness, as Jesus emphasizes that forgiving others' trespasses opens the way for our own forgiveness from the Father (Matthew 6:14; Mark 11:25). This forgiveness extends beyond mere tolerance, calling believers to respond gently and generously even toward those who wrong them, reflecting Christlike love and trust in the Lord rather than relying on human understanding (Proverbs 3:5; Proverbs 15:1; Proverbs 25:21). Peter's question about the limits of forgiveness highlights the biblical call to forgive repeatedly, demonstrating the boundless grace we have received.
